sent_back.title: A plate came back
sent_back.body: Table {table} sent back their {dish}. It wasn't up to scratch, and they look a bit glum.

remake.label: Cook it again
remake.description: Your chef drops everything for a few minutes to make a better one.
remake.outcome: A fresh {dish} went out to table {table}. Much better.

comp.label: Make it free
comp.description: Their whole meal is on the house ({cost}). They'll leave happy.
comp.outcome: You gave table {table} their meal for free. Big smiles.

apologise.label: Say sorry nicely
apologise.description: Your server pops over to apologise. Works better if they're charming.
apologise.outcome: {name} said sorry to table {table}. They seem calmer now.

sent_back.ignored: Nobody went back to table {table}. They're grumbling about the {dish}.

spill.title: A drink goes flying
spill.body: Someone knocked a drink over at table {table}. It's sticky and everyone's looking.

mop.label: Grab the mop
mop.description: Someone cleans it up straight away. Your floor is a little slower for a few minutes.
mop.outcome: Table {table} is clean and dry again.

leave.label: Leave it for now
leave.description: No time lost, but table {table} won't be impressed.
leave.outcome: The spill at table {table} stayed put. Not a great look.

spill.ignored: The spill at table {table} never got cleaned. Sticky shoes all round.

big_party.title: A big group at the door
big_party.body: A party of {size} wants to eat together, but your tables only seat a few each.

push.label: Push two tables together
push.description: Uses two free tables, and keeps a server busy for a few minutes. Big group, big bill.
push.outcome: You pushed two tables together for the party of {size}. They cheered. Loudly.

decline.label: Sorry, we're too small
decline.description: Turn them away politely. A little bit of popularity lost.
decline.outcome: You turned away the party of {size} with a smile.

big_party.ignored: The party of {size} waited, then wandered off. They'll tell their friends.

rush.title: Here comes a rush
rush.body: A coach has just pulled up outside and the queue is getting long.

callin.label: Call in extra help
callin.description: A friend comes in for an hour ({cost}). Faster kitchen and floor.
callin.outcome: Extra help arrived and the rush went smoothly.

simplify.label: Take {dish} off for today
simplify.description: Pull the slowest dish so the kitchen can keep up.
simplify.outcome: {dish} is off for today. The kitchen is flying now.

ride.label: Keep calm and carry on
ride.description: Do nothing special. Some people might get fed up waiting.

rush.ignored: The rush came and went. Hopefully nobody waited too long.

supplier_short.title: The delivery was short
supplier_short.body: This morning's {ingredient} delivery came {missing} portions short.

shop.label: Pop to the corner shop
shop.description: Buy {missing} portions now. It costs more than usual ({cost}).
shop.outcome: You bought {missing} {ingredient} from the corner shop. Back in business.

pull.label: Take {dish} off the menu
pull.description: Pull the dishes that need it for today. No extra cost.
pull.outcome: Dishes that need {ingredient} are off for today.

supplier_short.ignored: You didn't replace the missing {ingredient}. It might run out later.

equipment.title: The fryer has tripped
equipment.body: There's a pop and the fryer goes dark. The kitchen is slowing down.

fix.label: Fix it yourselves
fix.description: Your chef fiddles with it for a while. Free, but slow for a bit.
fix.outcome: Your chef got the fryer going again.

engineer.label: Call the engineer
engineer.outcome: The engineer had the fryer fixed in no time.

equipment.ignored: Nobody fixed the fryer, so the kitchen limped on for ages.

vip.title: There's a critic in
vip.body: The person at table {table} is writing in a small notebook between bites. That's a food critic.

best.label: Send your best server
best.description: {name} looks after them. A bit less help for everyone else for a while.
best.outcome: {name} is looking after the critic at table {table}.

freebie.label: Send a free treat
freebie.description: A little something from the kitchen ({cost}).
freebie.outcome: A free treat went out to the critic. They smiled, then wrote something down.

normal.label: Treat them like anyone else
normal.description: No fuss. Their review depends on the food and the wait.
normal.outcome: The critic got the same service as everyone else.

vip.ignored: The critic got the same service as everyone else.

staff_wobble.title: {name} is flagging
staff_wobble.body: {name} looks really tired and is starting to make mistakes.

break.label: Give them a break
break.description: {name} rests for half an hour. You're short-handed meanwhile.
break.outcome: {name} had a sit-down and a cup of tea. Back on form.

push.label: Ask them to push on
push.description: Keep going. {name} won't be happy about it.
push.outcome: {name} is pushing on, but isn't happy.

staff_wobble.ignored: Nobody noticed {name} struggling. They're feeling fed up.

INCIDENT_LINES.vipVerdictGood: The critic gave you {stars}★. Word is getting around.
INCIDENT_LINES.vipVerdictBad: The critic gave you {stars}★. Ouch, that will hurt your reputation.
INCIDENT_LINES.vipVerdictMeh: The critic gave you {stars}★. Not bad, not amazing.
INCIDENT_LINES.vipWalkout: The critic got fed up and walked out. That review will sting.
INCIDENT_LINES.closingTime: Service ended before anyone got to it.
INCIDENT_LINES.needTables: You need two free, clean tables for that. Wait a moment, or turn them away.
INCIDENT_LINES.porterMopped: {name} the porter mopped up a spill at table {table} before anyone noticed.
INCIDENT_LINES.noStockRemake: There's no {dish} stock left to cook another one.
INCIDENT_LINES.notOnFloor: {name} isn't on the floor right now.
INCIDENT_LINES.shortDeliveryLog: Oh no, the {ingredient} delivery came {missing} short.
